meta.name: neko-plugin
meta.description: Work on N.E.K.O plugins end to end. Use when the user asks to create, modify, review, run, debug, inspect, document, validate, package, or reason about N.E.K.O plugins, plugin.toml, plugin SDK usage, plugin UI surfaces, plugin CLI tooling, plugin runtime behavior, or plugin system contracts.

copy.tagline: 对 N.E.K.O 插件进行全生命周期管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要创建、修改或调试 N.E.K.O 插件
copy.tagline_en: Manage the full lifecycle of N.E.K.O plugins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create, modify, or debug N.E.K.O plugins

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能处理 N.E.K.O 插件的完整生命周期：创建、修改、调试、审查、文档、验证、打包等。它会读取标准文件，使用命令行生成脚手架，仅在指定工作区内编辑代码，并自检后才输出结果。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、修改、审查 N.E.K.O 插件，或涉及 plugin.toml、SDK 用法、UI、CLI 工具、运行时行为等时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 N.E.K.O 插件，名叫‘通知管理器’。
say.note: Claude 会询问必要信息并生成结构。

say.text: 检查这个插件的 plugin.toml 配置是否有问题。
say.note: Claude 会读取合约并验证。
Claude 会按流程检查状态和代码。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can handle the full lifecycle of N.E.K.O plugins: create, modify, debug, review, document, validate, package, etc. It reads standard references, uses CLI scaffolds, edits only within the designated workspace, and self-reviews before reporting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create, modify, review N.E.K.O plugins, or when dealing with plugin.toml, SDK usage, UI, CLI tooling, runtime behavior, etc.

say_en.text: Create a new N.E.K.O plugin named 'Notification Manager'.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions and scaffold it.

say_en.text: Check if this plugin's plugin.toml is correct.
